name: continue
description: The boot and the title, then Continue with a card holding new_game's save in File 1 (tests/saves/run.py gives it: the port's or the emulator's): the load screen (OPENSEG's memory card screen, mode 7) reads both cards' files, File 1 is loaded and applied (OPEN_applyLoadedSave), and the saved game resumes in its area: SAISEG, Beginner City. The checkpoint `loaded` hashes the loaded profile. Not a replay script of its own (no record: it needs the card), so it is not in tests/replay/scripts.

steps.comment: PLAYER_PROFILES allocated by initPlayerData, at the address probes.lua hashes
OPENSEG loaded: the opening movie's overlay
START opens the menu (OPEN_TITLE_STATE 8), its cursor on Continue
Continue: the load screen reads the cards and shows the files (OPEN_MEMCARD.state 10)
File 1: 'Do you want to Load File1?' opens, its cursor on No (initDialog's default)
Yes: the file is read (state 9), its checksum checked and the profile applied (state 25)
'Load complete' (state 12) waits for a press; a corrupted file would stop at state 15
close the load screen: the game resumes in the saved area (resumeInArea), SAISEG (overlay id 6)
